asked.item: Which template for a made-up person talking to camera, selfie style

verdict.reason: The help pages name the AI Selfie Talking Video with Consistent Character template for a generated character talking to the camera, and say where to find it.

steps.text: Pick the "AI Selfie Talking Video with Consistent Character" template for a generated character video.
It is meant for a consistent AI-generated character (not your real face) and for videos where a character "talks to the camera".
In the web app, open Videos > Create New Video and select it there.
